title: 8 attempted suicides by sailors in USS Lincoln strike group during deployment, navy letter says
summary: According to a letter from the acting Navy secretary, there were eight attempted suicides by sailors in the USS Lincoln strike group during the vessel's 10-month deployment. Charlie D'Agata has more.
